mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.5%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales growth signal a broad-based consumer demand slowdown that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 30% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) during a supply chain disruption signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate margins and trigger negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) during INDPRO < 105.0 periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales growth below 0.5% (annualized) over the past month signals weak consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS growth is below 0.5% (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 237.0) combined with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals impending policy tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) during CPIAUCSL>237.0 and FEDFUNDS<0.5% periods.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 100,000 jobs per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs/month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) over the past month signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0.
